title: Transport of a bounded-above finite-free open model
statement: Let $h:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $V\subset S$ open. Let $K$ be a bounded-above cochain complex of module sheaves on the open site over $V$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], representing $E|_V$. Fix $n:\mathbf Z\to\mathbf N$ and isomorphisms $K^i\cong\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n(i)}$ in every degree [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Derived categories on schemes use one universe; those on the open sites of $S$ are supplied in that universe. For each $t\in T$ with $h(t)\in V$, there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $t$ and a bounded-above complex $P$ on $U$ with $P^i\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n(i)}$ in every degree, and $L(U\hookrightarrow T)^*Lh^*E\cong Q(P)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. No Tor-amplitude or cohomology-rank hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Set U to the inverse image of V, and transport K to V.toScheme by the exact open-site equivalence A. The equivalence preserves free terms by mapFreeIso and identifies unit sheaves. It preserves zero objects, hence the upper bound. Every finite-free term is flat by flatness of coproducts of the tensor unit. The bounded-above flat criterion makes this transported complex K-flat.

Apply the K-flat counit in exists_derivedPullback to the restricted morphism U.toScheme to V.toScheme. Identify tensor pullback with module pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. Define P as its termwise pullback. Module pullback sends free terms to free terms with the same index types and sends zero terms to zero terms; the bounds and ranks follow.

A K-flat resolution of an arbitrary object identifies derived open pullback with exact open restriction followed by the open-site equivalence. Apply this to Lh*E, then apply the universe-aware derived pullback/open-restriction comparison. Transport the given representing isomorphism through the exact equivalence and the restricted derived pullback, and compose with the K-flat counit isomorphism. These explicit compositions give the required isomorphism to Q(P).

theorem finiteFreeResidueModel_pullback
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ V : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S) (V : S.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ)
    (n : ℤ → ℕ)
    (hbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (hrank : ∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over V) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n i)))))
    (hmodel : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S) (t : T) (ht : h t ∈ V) :
    ∃ U : T.Opens, t ∈ U ∧
      ∃ P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty (P.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n i))))) ∧
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj ((derivedPullback h).obj E) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
